payload.body:
**ID:** MP-CGA-002 | **Priority:** P0 | **PRD refs:** FR5 | **Status:** draft
**Group:** MP Content Generation Agent (`mp-content-generation-agent`)

---

# Add diagnostics contract resource and persistence for content-generation runs

## Summary

There is currently no persisted record of content-generation invocation outcomes. This ticket introduces a new `content_generation_run` (or equivalent) resource into the `@workspace/agent-data-api-contract`, creates the Prisma model and migration, implements the API route and service, and updates the SDK so that the agent (MP-CGA-007) and the Hermes UI (MP-CGA-010) can write and read diagnostic records without touching raw HTTP paths.

## Scope

- In scope:
  - Define a new resource in `agentDataApiManifest` in `@workspace/agent-data-api-contract` (e.g. `contentGenerationRuns`): at minimum a `POST /content-generation/runs` to create a record and a `GET /content-generation/runs` to list/filter.
  - Define Zod schemas for the POST request body and GET query parameters (filters: `tickerId`, `outcome`, `startTime`, `endTime`; pagination as needed), and for the response shape.
  - Required fields in the create body schema:
    - `agentId` (literal `"content-generation"`)
    - `agentVersion` (string)
    - `tickerId` (string)
    - `outcome` (`"success" | "skipped" | "failed"`)
    - `stage` (optional; `"precheck" | "llm" | "validate" | "persist"`)
    - `errorCode` (optional string — see FR4 taxonomy)
    - `errorCategory` (optional string)
    - `message` (optional string; sanitized, no secrets)
    - `durationMs` (optional number)
    - `pipelineRunId` (optional string — correlation id from Hermes caller)
    - `newsletterId` (optional string — set on success)
  - Add a `ContentGenerationRun` Prisma model in `packages/mediapulse/database/prisma/schema.prisma`; generate and commit the migration.
  - Implement route and service handlers in `apps/mediapulse/agent-data-api`; register the resource in the typed handler map used by `registerAgentDataApiRoutes`.
  - Update `@workspace/agent-data-api-client` with typed methods for creating and listing diagnostic runs.
  - Tests: route/service (create record, list with filters), SDK method.
  - Update `dev-docs/docs/mediapulse/apps/agent-data-api.mdx`.
- Out of scope:
  - The agent-side call that writes a diagnostic on each invocation (MP-CGA-007).
  - The Hermes UI that reads from this endpoint (MP-CGA-010).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `agentDataApiManifest` includes the new `contentGenerationRuns` resource with typed route entries (no hardcoded path strings in app or client code).
- [ ] `POST /content-generation/runs` creates a record; responds with the created record including a generated `id` and `createdAt`.
- [ ] `GET /content-generation/runs` returns a paginated list filterable by `tickerId`, `outcome`, and time range (`startTime` / `endTime`); results default to newest-first.
- [ ] `ContentGenerationRun` Prisma model has all required fields; nullable fields are explicitly typed optional.
- [ ] Prisma migration generated and committed; `db:migrate:dev` applies cleanly.
- [ ] `@workspace/agent-data-api-client` exposes typed `contentGenerationRuns.create(...)` and `contentGenerationRuns.list(...)` methods that use the manifest-driven paths (no raw strings).
- [ ] Message and errorCode fields **never** store raw API keys or secrets (enforced by documentation and code review; sanitization responsibility lies with the agent caller — MP-CGA-007).
- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover: create with all fields, create with only required fields, list with filters, list without filters (returns all recent).
- [ ] `pnpm code-quality` passes with no new errors.
- [ ] `dev-docs` updated to document the new resource.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none
- Blocks: MP-CGA-007, MP-CGA-010

## Stacked delivery

This ticket ships a new additive resource. Existing routes and the agent are unaffected. No feature flag is required — the new endpoint exists but nothing writes to or reads from it until MP-CGA-007 and MP-CGA-010 land.

**Merge order:** Ship this ticket to `main` before MP-CGA-007 and MP-CGA-010. Both of those tickets branch from (or rebase onto) this ticket's merged state.

## Notes

- Follow the `agent-data-api-endpoints` skill: new resource → add to manifest → server route + service → typed handler map → SDK → tests → docs.
- Follow `prisma-migrate-dev` skill: edit schema only, run `db:migrate:dev` for migration SQL generation.
- The PRD mentions "additive resources" and a greenfield pattern since no existing diagnostics shape exists in the shared contract. Align the model name and table name with whatever naming convention is established once the first diagnostics PR is open (e.g. `ContentGenerationRun` / `content_generation_run`).
- Index the `ContentGenerationRun` table on `(tickerId, createdAt)` and `(outcome, createdAt)` for efficient filtered queries from the Hermes UI.
- `pipelineRunId`: the Hermes scheduler may pass a correlation id in the invocation context; include it as optional for future tracing even if not populated initially.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/content-generation-agent-prd.md
